prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 20:9 overscan master candidate for a game GUI facility background in the Element Maze JRPG static prototype. Primary request: Create an Earth-region magic shop background in Japanese visual novel fantasy CG style, anime-style JRPG facility art, for later cropping to a 1672x941 GUI background. Scene/backdrop: A hot and humid Earth-region root-and-stone magic shop built inside an old quarry shrine and living tree-root chamber. Interior has dark timber shelves, carved leyline stone arches, moss, hanging dried herbs, sealed spellbooks with no readable writing, root-bound crystal lamps, green-gold leyline veins in the walls, mushroom-shaped candle stands, brass instruments, geode prisms, clay incense bowls, and woven shade screens. Keep readable left and middle background depth for GUI panels; the room must feel like a working magic shop, not an empty cave or pure outdoor forest. Subject: Eve, adult female elf-like magic shop keeper, visual-only candidate NPC. Make her clearly distinct from Rabi the shopkeeper and the synthesis artisan: sharper and more mysterious expression, pointed ears visible, neck-length short angular bob or asymmetrical short hair ending around the neck, dark jade-black or deep auburn hair, gold-green eyes, calm observant gaze. She wears conservative hot-climate mage-merchant clothing: sleeveless or cap-sleeved charcoal-linen high-neck top, moss-green and deep teal cropped mantle, thin brass clasps, waist sash with small crystal tools, no heavy coat, no winter layers, no exposed chest or bare midriff. She is medium-close half-body in the right foreground, one hand near a closed spellbook, geode prism, or brass astrolabe with no readable text, face in the upper-right safe zone with breathing room from the image edge, hands and work counter visible. Style/medium: polished 2D anime fantasy game background, Japanese visual novel facility CG, clean elegant linework, mature painterly JRPG texture, soft but distinct facial features, detailed but not cluttered. Composition/framing: extra-wide 20:9 landscape overscan. Design the central 80% so it can crop cleanly to 16:9. Keep Eve medium-close on the right or center-right, face around x 68%-82% and y 14%-34% of the eventual 16:9 crop, not cropped. Preserve usable left/middle space for GUI list and detail panels. Lower counter, hands, spellbook, and geode tools may be partly hidden by GUI panels; face and core torso must remain safe. Lighting/mood: humid sacred-magical interior, warm amber resin lamps, muted green-gold leyline glow, small teal crystal highlights, cool filtered forest window light, quiet mysterious shop atmosphere. Color palette: deep moss green, dark teal, charcoal linen, warm amber, muted gold-green, dark timber brown, clay terracotta, cyan-green crystal highlights. Materials/textures: carved quarry stone, living roots, moss, brass, geodes, crystals, dried herbs, clay incense, dark timber, linen, woven reed shade screens. Constraints: no in-image text, no readable signs, no UI panels, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark, no captions.
